These are intuition-based estimates from the structure of the search space, not values looked up from the benchmark.

- **Replacing a strong op with a weaker one** (claims 2, 6, 7): I expect the drop to be larger than average, so the effect is LOWER, not higher.
- **Edits that become irrelevant** (claim 18): edge 2 only feeds node 3 through edge 5, so setting it has almost no effect when edge 5 is none.
- **Replacing `none` with a real op** (claim 20): this should give a bigger gain than replacing an op that already works.
- **Skip edits when other paths are cut** (claims 1, 23): the skip path should matter more when alternatives are removed.
- **Everything else:** I saw no strong interaction, so I kept these low, around 15–30.
